title: Singularity SMP
description: Singularity SMP is a modded smp that is based on Magic/Dungeons.
body:
Singularity SMP is a modded Magic/Dungeons focused SMP on 1.21.1 NeoForge!
Custom worldgen, epic bosses, dungeons, Lifesteal enchantments, light tech, and Friendly Anarchy rules.
PvP & griefing allowed — but keep it fun and not toxic.
No map resets. Come build, explore, and cause chaos!

Join the Discord :
- https://discord.gg/EDym8mahgW
